# Open Science and Data Availability (ICSE SEET 2027)

The SEET track follows ICSE 2027 Open Science policies. Guiding principle: research results should be **publicly accessible** and empirical studies **reproducible** whenever possible.

## Requirements

- **Mandatory:** every submission must include a **`Data Availability` section after the Conclusion**, stating either:
  - links to anonymized data/repositories, or
  - a **short statement justifying why data cannot be shared**.
- Sharing data is **not mandatory** for submission or acceptance, but **non-sharing must be justified**.

## Accepted Reasons for Non-Sharing

- Non-Disclosure Agreements
- Ethics Review Board restrictions (participant privacy)
- Commercial-in-confidence source code

## Notes

- Qualitative research: reproducibility/replicability is **not a goal**; see ICSE 2027 Open Science guidelines for reporting qualitative research.
- Indemnified/limited data sharing is possible through the HotCRP supplementary-material upload option.
- **After acceptance:** supplementary material can be submitted to the **ICSE 2027 Artifact Evaluation** track for recognition as Reusable / Available / Replicated / Reproduced.

## Useful Resources Cited in the CfP

- GitHub → Zenodo archive: https://guides.github.com/activities/citable-code/
- GitHub → figshare: https://knowledge.figshare.com/articles/item/how-to-connect-figshare-with-your-github-account
- SIGSOFT artifact evaluation proposal: https://github.com/acmsigsoft/artifact-evaluation
- Open science proposal for SE (artifact structure): https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06499
